comments_text: APETx4 is able to selectively inhibit the human ether-à-go-go channel (hEag1 or KV10.1), which a cancer-relevant voltage-gated potassium channel that is overexpressed in a majority of human tumors.
cytotoxicity_text: NIH-3T3: KV10.1 Expression Level (Undetectable); Human epithelial cell line hTERT RPE-1: KV10.1 Expression Level (Moderate)
target_organism_text: Tumor cells: MDA-MB-435S (KV10.1 Expression Level: Moderate)
title: APETx4, a Novel Sea Anemone Toxin and a Modulator of the Cancer-Relevant Potassium Channel KV10.1
